$comment: Models the conversation lab (docs/runbooks/conversation-lab.md) calls itself, besides the app's own models from infra/cdk/config/production.json. Each list is tried in order; the first model that answers a one-token probe is used, and the run prints which. The FoundryAscent-ConversationLab role (infra/cdk/src/stacks/foundation-stack.ts) may invoke exactly these ids and the app's. Prices: Amazon Bedrock on-demand, us-east-1, USD per million tokens (checked 2026-10-17); the lab meters its own calls with them. The live suite (conversation_lab/live) uses its own lists under "live": a simulator and a judge from model families other than the app's (Amazon Nova), falling back to Nova when the account has not enabled them; the run reports which family played and judged. Their prices are the higher of the published on-demand figures checked 2026-11-05 (verify on the Bedrock pricing page): metering high keeps the hard caps safe. The production coach is Amazon Nova 2 Lite (infra/cdk/config/production.json, ADR-0024), so the live suite's judge on auto is the first "judge" candidate of another family: Claude Haiku 4.5, then Llama 4 Maverick (Nova Premier never judges a Nova coach). The live suite's "coach" list holds the alternative coach models a lab run may put the app's coach on for an A/B (the coach_model input of ops-live-evals.yml; the lab's API process only, never production's configuration): Nova 2 Lite (production's coach since 2026-11-24, here as primary and fallback alone), Claude Sonnet 4.6 and GPT-6 Luna (ADR-0024; its input is priced at its cache-write rate, the most a Luna input token can be billed). Claude prices are the us. (regional) on-demand rates, 10% above the global list price. "benchmark" is the models suite (conversation_lab/models_bench.py): reasoning models (each at the reasoning efforts listed), embedding models (at the vector sizes listed) and rerankers it compares, with production's own search measured on each model's vectors; a candidate the account cannot call is reported by its AWS error code, never fatal. Embedding and reasoning prices there are packages/ai/src/pricing.ts's; a reranker is billed per query (at most 100 documents), in the region named (Amazon Rerank 1.0 is not offered in us-east-1).
